description: Base token heuristic screening plus DexScreener market data, source and retrieval time. Returns owner, paused and proxy facts with limited selector checks. A mint selector does not prove callable minting; missing or unavailable evidence remains unknown. Illustrative examples are not live quotes. Not a safety guarantee; see endpoint details for coverage limits. Use before swapping into an unfamiliar Base token. Example: address=0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
